description: Monorepo-architect patterns for ModMe federated dual-stack workflow gates

federated-dual-stack.title: Federated dual-stack
federated-dual-stack.principle: Independent monorepos; HTTP/WebSocket integration only; no workspace:* cross-imports

path-filtered-ci.title: Path-filtered CI
path-filtered-ci.principle: Single stack-paths manifest drives CI, pre-push hooks, and agent verify

contract-first-integration.title: Contract-first integration
contract-first-integration.principle: Golden Zod schemas and WS contracts before UI migration cutover

bounded-parallel-agents.title: Bounded parallel agents
bounded-parallel-agents.principle: Serial plan, parallel exploration waves, serial commit

ecl-structured-change.title: ECL structured change
ecl-structured-change.principle: Harness lint gates structural and cross-stack changes
